subject: Maths
title: Mixed times table practice
subtitle: Multiplication and Division (3, 4, 8 Times Tables) · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can fluently recall and use multiplication and division facts up to 12 × 12.

key_vocab.definition: Fluency means recalling a multiplication fact in under 2 seconds, without counting on fingers.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can fluently recall and use multiplication and division facts up to 12 × 12.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Fluency -- Fluency means recalling a multiplication fact in under 2 seconds, without counting on fingers.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiplication is commutative: a × b = b × a. So you only need to learn HALF the table.
7 × 8 = 8 × 7 = 56
Same answer either way

Key examples:
  ✓ 8 × 6 = 48  (fact)
  ✓ 48 ÷ 6 = 8  (linked)
  ✓ 7 × 9 = 63  (fact)
  ✗ 7 × 8 = 54  (should be 56)
  ✗ 9 × 6 = 56  (should be 54)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – fact recall
  Calculate 7 × 8
  Think: 7 × 8 = 8 × 7
  = (7 × 7) + 7
  = 49 + 7
  = 56
  (If you know 7×7=49, just add one more 7.)

Example 2 – missing factor
  Solve: 6 × ___ = 54
  54 ÷ 6
  Count up in 6s: 6,12,...,54
  = 9
  = 9
  (9 sixes make 54.)

sections.title: Quick recall
sections.content:
Answer as quickly as you can.

(a) 6 × 7 = ___
(b) 8 × 9 = ___
(c) 11 × 5 = ___
(d) 12 × 4 = ___
